description: This file is a Markdown documentation page covering how to implement custom request classes and custom route classes in FastAPI, including use cases like handling compressed requests and accessing request bodies in exception handlers.

classes.name: GzipRequest
classes.description: A custom subclass of Request that decompresses gzip-encoded request bodies.

classes.name: GzipRoute
classes.description: A custom subclass of APIRoute that uses GzipRequest for handling requests.

methods.name: GzipRequest.body
methods.description: Method overridden to decompress gzip content if the header indicates encoding gzip.

methods.name: GzipRoute.get_route_handler
methods.description: Overrides the default method to use GzipRequest instead of Request.
